source_positions.position: Do not feed sweet/bell pepper fruit
Chemical composition of sweet pepper genotypes; not a tortoise feeding trial
Seven color/source-specific raw pepper fruit nutrient records; none establishes tortoise feeding safety

interpretation.confirmed: Nutrient composition differs by fruit color; USDA Foundation Foods Ca:P below 1 in four colors
interpretation.not_confirmed: Safe feeding frequency, dose, chronic outcomes, toxicity threshold or direct tortoise trial
interpretation.risk_of_current_reasoning: Absence of published toxicity evidence is not affirmative evidence of feeding safety; a chemical composition study does not override specialist avoidance guidance
interpretation.recommended_action: Expert review of grade C and rationale before changing public suitability; avoid automatically promoting or downgrading based on nutrient ratios alone
